request.description:
A5/rule 8 ('two renderers, they cannot disagree'). For cloud runs the Worker composes its own doc (status.ts:431-495: no health, progress, workers or ci, waves null, phase from run.state, one cost line) while `ticfac watch run_<hex>` builds the full Go model, so the same cloud run shows a verdict, table and per-source cost in the terminal and a bare state chip on the phone. On the same pushed document the phone prints 'degraded: degraded: …' (phone.ts:612 prefixes a summary verdict.go:117-131 already prefixes) and 'stopped: ' for an empty summary, and omits the workers panel, CI line and elapsed. Fix: render cloud runs on the phone from the same model (push or serve the Go-built doc), share the verdict wording, and add a cross-renderer test over the degraded and stopped goldens.
evidence: cloudflare/src/status.ts:431-495; cloudflare/src/phone.ts:612; internal/statusmodel/verdict.go:117-131; internal/cli/watch_view.go:241

ticfac run epic-hn6 created this tick by absorbing the finding a1b0f94a3436677462d848d3a5b7be23c0773fc16fcb7536033f5c82a782ac9c (reported by run-epic-hn6/tick-v16/attempt-1): the finding was judged against the epic's definition of done and gates done item A5. The decision record — item id, verdict, observed or predicted, confidence — is .ticfac/runs/epic-hn6/absorptions/a1b0f94a3436677462d848d3a5b7be23c0773fc16fcb7536033f5c82a782ac9c.json on the run branch.
request.title: Phone page shows a different model for cloud runs and garbles verdicts
